mapper.select: SELECT id FROM tb_user WHERE username = #{username} AND password = MD5(CONCAT(MD5(#{username}),#{password})) LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT p.permission_name FROM tb_user u JOIN tb_role r ON JSON_CONTAINS(u.role, CAST(r.id AS CHAR)) JOIN tb_permission p ON JSON_CONTAINS(r.permissions, CAST(p.id AS CHAR)) WHERE u.id = #{userId} AND u.status = 1
SELECT u.name, d.dept_name AS deptName FROM tb_user u JOIN tb_dept d ON u.dept_id = d.id WHERE u.id = #{userId} AND u.`status` = 1
SELECT id, `name` FROM tb_user WHERE status = 1
SELECT id, username, name, sex, tel, email, role, dept_id AS deptId, status FROM tb_user WHERE id = #{userId}
SELECT u.name, d.dept_name AS dept FROM tb_user u LEFT JOIN tb_dept d ON u.dept_id = d.id WHERE u.id = #{userId} AND u.status = 1
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_user SET password = MD5(CONCAT(MD5(username),#{newPassword})) WHERE id = #{userId} AND password = MD5(CONCAT(MD5(username),#{oldPassword}))
